items.prebattleFilterButton/body:

items.extraParams/artNotificationDelayFactor: This parameter shows the time between the SPG shot and receiving the warning.
items.extraParams/commanderLampDelay: This parameter shows the delay before the Commander identifies if your vehicle has been spotted by the enemy. The higher the value, the shorter the delay.
items.extraParams/crewHitChance: This parameter shows the chance of avoiding injuries for your crew members.
items.extraParams/crewRepeatedStunDuration: This parameter shows the duration of additional stun for an already stunned vehicle.
items.extraParams/crewStunDuration: This parameter shows the duration of the received stun.
items.extraParams/damageAndPiercingDistributio: This parameter shows the change of the minimum potential damage and potential penetration value compared to the base value (-25%).
This parameter shows the change of the maximum potential damage and potential penetration value compared to the base value (+25%).
items.extraParams/damageEnemiesByRamming: This parameter shows the amount of damage caused by ramming. When vehicles collide, the system considers the thickness of armor at the point of impact, the difference in the vehicles' weights, and their speeds.
items.extraParams/damagedModulesDetectionTime: This parameter shows the delay before the Commander detects critical damage to the enemy vehicle in your reticle.
items.extraParams/demaskFoliageFactor: This parameter shows the exposure of enemies that are fully concealed by foliage (both isolated and grouped foliage). Applies to stationary and moving vehicles.
items.extraParams/demaskMovingFactor: This parameter shows the exposure of moving enemy vehicles. The higher the value, the higher the chances of spotting.
items.extraParams/enemyModulesCrewCritChance: This parameter shows the changes to the chance of causing critical damage to enemy crew and modules. The effect works for all types of shells except in vehicles with autocannons.
items.extraParams/equipmentPreparationTime: This parameter shows the cooldown time of consumables.
items.extraParams/fireExtinguishingRate: This parameter determines the decrease to a fire's duration and the amount of damage it causes.
items.extraParams/foliageMaskingFactor: This parameter shows the effect of concealment behind foliage.
items.extraParams/hpRecover: This parameter shows the increase in HP restored when using a Repair Kit. The higher the value, the more HP will be restored.
items.extraParams/mediumGroundFactor: This parameter shows the crossing capacity of the suspension on moderately soft terrain. The higher the value, the less time is required to reach linear speed.
items.extraParams/penaltyToDamagedSurveyingDev: This parameter reduces the penalty to maximum viewing distance when observation devices are destroyed. The lower the value, the better the visibility.
items.extraParams/piercingHEShellsDistribution: This parameter shows the increase in maximum potential penetration value for shells at distances of less than 50 m. The higher the value, the better the penetration.
items.extraParams/radiomanActivityTimeAfterVeh: This parameter shows the additional transmission time of enemy positions after your vehicle is destroyed.
items.extraParams/radiomanHitChance: This parameter shows the chance of avoiding injuries to your Radio Operator.
items.extraParams/shellVelocity: This parameter shows the increase in shell velocity for all shell types. The higher the value, the higher the shell velocity.
items.extraParams/softGroundFactor: This parameter shows the crossing capacity of the suspension on soft terrain. The higher the value, the less time is required to reach linear speed.
items.extraParams/stunResistanceEffectFactor: This parameter shows the degree of negative effects from crew stunning.
items.extraParams/suspensionDamageReduction: This parameter shows the reduction in incoming damage to suspension. The higher the value, the less damage will be received.
items.extraParams/vehPenaltyForDamagedAmmorack: This parameter shows the reduction in the penalty to gun reload time due to a damaged ammo rack. The higher the value, the shorter the loading time.
items.extraParams/vehPenaltyForDamagedEngine: This parameter shows the decrease in power lost by a damaged engine. The higher the value, the less power the engine will lose.
items.extraParams/vehicleAmmoBayEngineFuelStre: This parameter shows the durability of the ammo rack, fuel tanks, and engine. The higher the value, the more durable your modules.
items.extraParams/vehicleAmmoBayStrength: This parameter shows the durability of the ammo rack. The higher the value, the more durable your ammo rack.
items.extraParams/vehicleChassisFallDamage: This parameter shows the damage caused by suspension damage during impact. It does not affect the damage caused to the side or top of the turret during impact.
items.extraParams/vehicleChassisRepairSpeed: This parameter shows the speed of suspension repairs. The higher the value, the faster the speed of repairs.
items.extraParams/vehicleChassisStrength: This parameter shows the durability of the suspension. The higher the value, the more durable your suspension against both shells and impact/ramming.
items.extraParams/vehicleEnemySpottingTime: This parameter shows the duration enemies are visible after they leave your visibility range. The default value is 10 seconds.
items.extraParams/vehicleFallingDamageResistan: This parameter shows the reduction of damage received by a vehicle upon impact. The higher the value, the less damage will be received.
items.extraParams/vehicleFireChance: This parameter shows the chance of engine fire when it is damaged.
items.extraParams/vehicleFuelTankLesionChance: This parameter shows the durability of fuel tanks against critical damage. Upon destruction, fuel tanks always cause a fire.
items.extraParams/vehicleGunShotDispersion: This parameter shows the reduction in gun accuracy upon movement, hull and turret traverse. The lower the value, the smaller the dispersion of the aiming circle.
items.extraParams/vehicleGunShotDispersionAfte: This parameter shows the size of the aiming circle after firing.
items.extraParams/vehicleGunShotDispersionChas: This parameter shows dispersion during movement. The lower the value, the more accurate the gun.
This parameter shows the dispersion during hull traverse. The lower the value, the more accurate the gun.
items.extraParams/vehicleGunShotDispersionTurr: This parameter shows the dispersion during gun traverse. The lower the value, the more accurate the gun.
items.extraParams/vehicleGunShotDispersionWhil: This parameter shows dispersion with a damaged gun. The higher the value, the lower the dispersion.
items.extraParams/vehicleHEShellDamageResistan: This parameter shows damage received from HE shells. The more armor in the area of impact, the higher the effect.
items.extraParams/vehicleInvisibilityAfterShot: This parameter shows the concealment after firing.
items.extraParams/vehicleOwnSpottingTime: This parameter shows the duration your vehicle is visible to enemies after you leave their view range. The default value is 10 s.
items.extraParams/vehicleRamChassisDamageResis: This parameter shows the amount of damage to suspension received from ramming. When vehicles collide, the system considers the thickness of the armor at the point of impact, the difference in the vehicles' weights, and their speeds.
items.extraParams/vehicleRamDamageResistance: This parameter shows the amount of damage received from ramming. When vehicles collide, the system considers the thickness of the armor at the point of impact, the difference in the vehicles' weights, and their speeds.
items.extraParams/vehicleReloadTimeAfterShellC: This parameter shows the speed when switching between shell types in a loaded gun.
items.extraParams/vehicleRepairSpeed: This parameter shows the speed of internal and external module repairs from the "red" state to the "yellow" state. The higher the value, the faster the repairs.
items.extraParams/vehicleSpeedGain: This parameter shows the crossing capacity of the suspension. The higher the value, the less time is required to reach linear speed.
items.extraParams/wheelsRotationSpeed: This parameter shows the speed of changing direction for a wheeled vehicle.
items.extraParams/woundedCrewEfficiency: This parameter shows the decrease of penalties to the major qualification for any crew member when they are injured (except for the Commander).
